articles.summary: –Received Positive Pre-Investigational New Drug (“IND”) Written Feedback from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (“FDA”)– –Clinical Advisory Board (“CAB”) Includes Key Leaders across Neuropsychiatry, Anesthesiology, and Clinical Development – –Remain On Track to Initiate CYC-126's Phase 2
articles.title: Cyclerion Therapeutics Announces Progress Toward CYC-126 Phase 2 Proof-of-Concept Study with FDA Feedback and Formation of Clinical Advisory Board
